## Arm and service-storage concept
2026-11-17: upper arms and forearms now use smooth native lofted Spline Patches, two sources plus two mirrored-side Instances. Each source has 20 controls and 36 segments. Original straight extrusion envelopes remain hidden/recoverable. Existing shoulder/elbow/wrist datums, hierarchy and timeline are unchanged. Frames 0/90/180/330 produced finite bounds and no build errors; this is not swept collision, wall-thickness or strength validation. Upper length200mm, fore length180mm (original fore envelope181mm); panel ends and internal structure are unresolved. Lower service bay adds a rear panel and three 800x140x18mm front-panel layout envelopes for parts/tools/service storage; these are not complete drawers, and guides/handles/load ratings/anchoring remain to be designed. Upper shelf stays open.
